key_insight: Two complementary circuit-simplification methods enable deterministic amplitude encoding with low two-qubit gate costs and tunable depth–fidelity trade-offs.
engineering_relevance: Shallower data-loading circuits could make quantum applications more practical on near-term hardware by reducing noise accumulated before computation begins.
method: Map redundant-control elimination in multiplexer circuits to Boolean logic minimization.
Use one ancilla qubit and the Walsh–Hadamard spectrum of rotation angles to decompose multi-controlled rotations.
Hybridize both methods and use tensor networks to support data or queryable functions beyond classical memory capacity.
evidence_signal: Benchmarks across function classes report up to orders-of-magnitude lower depth than Qiskit's default state preparation at equivalent fidelity, alongside an IQM square-lattice hardware demonstration.
watch_item: Depth advantages benchmarked with all-to-all connectivity may be reduced by routing overhead on connectivity-constrained hardware.
paper_title: Scalable Unitary State-Encoding for Generic Large Data
